The '''Weerden system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corusca sector/Legends|Corusca sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weerden]].
